title: FamCal Event Duration Leaderboard
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=famcal:event duration_min=*
| stats sum(duration_min) as total_value, avg(duration_min) as avg_value by calendar_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks calendar values by total and average duration across FamCal event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `duration_min` values for each FamCal event event and review total and average duration by calendar.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total duration.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly which calendar shows the biggest duration numbers in your FamCal event data.
